plugins.description: Armory — aggregator-of-aggregators. One install gives your agent the Armory MCP server (search + install across 24,000+ components spanning MCPs, skills, sub-agents, hooks, rules, and commands) plus 2,546 vendored components ready to use immediately. Works with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, and Hermes.
